prompt:
Create ONE large boss monster sprite for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG battle (a single figure).

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: the light-grey box shows where the boss stands and how big it is (fill the box), the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the boss faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, crisp cel shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero.

Image 3 is the APPROVED LOOK of this exact boss in its idle pose (pixel art). Keep the identical design, armour, colours, proportions and size; only the pose changes.

Render as true pixel art: the boss about 140-168 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, rich detail and 3-4 tones per colour like a premium modern pixel-art boss.

Boss: the Rime Sovereign, a towering gaunt undead knight-king in tall layered blackened-iron plate armour with frost creeping over every edge, broad swept-back pauldrons shaped like frozen wings, a long tattered grey-blue mantle hanging from the shoulders; no helmet: a bare cracked skull with a crown of jagged icicles growing out of the bone and a thin rim of old tarnished gold, two pale cyan pinpoints of light deep in the eye sockets; he wields a long two-handed glaive whose blade is clouded blue ice with faint cyan rune light running down the dark haft; palette of blackened iron, frost white, glacier blue and cyan glow with a single accent of tarnished gold. FACE: the skull face with two pale cyan eye lights and a toothed jaw is readable.

Pose: staggered back by a heavy blow: still facing right with the chest and the skull face toward the viewer as in Image 3, the whole body leaning back to the left away from the heroes, the skull head with its ice crown upright on the neck and in full view, one head only, the free arm thrown out to the side (never across the face), knees buckling; the glaive held the same way round as in Image 3, in the same hand, its ice blade low on the right and its spearhead end up on the left, dipping toward the ground; cracks and small ice shards bursting from the chest armour, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right, facing right.

MOVEMENT: this is a dramatic ACTION frame of a huge, intimidating boss, not a static stance. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight clearly onto one leg, twist the torso, extend the limbs and weapon far from the body, and let the mantle and loose armour edges fly with the motion. The silhouette must be very different from the idle reference. Limbs, mantle and weapon may reach beyond the sides of the grey box. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

Only the boss: no other characters, no scenery, no floor tiles, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no shadows, no borders, no panels.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a helmet or mask covering the skull, a sword, skulls on the shoulders, a throne, a second weapon.
